notes: FROZEN -- no phases. agent_supports: no. kiro-cli 2.6.0 raises no blocking dialog that belongs to no tool call and is reachable from a prompt. All four triggers the row lists were checked with strings(1) against both shipped binaries (the 103MB launcher `kiro-cli` and the 530MB `kiro-cli-chat`, which is the REPL surface -- `kiro-cli chat --help` reports usage as `kiro-cli-chat chat`). (1) SANDBOX / NETWORK-ACCESS CONFIRMATION: absent. `network access`, `allow network`, `internet access` = 0 hits in either binary; `sandbox` = 58 hits in the chat binary and 0 in the launcher, every one a bundled syntax grammar or keyword list (twig, CSP directives, vim, LSL, React HTML attributes, T-SQL) except the prose of the --trust-all-tools warning. (2) FIRST-USE TRUST PROMPT for a workspace or a configured server: `do you trust`, `trust the files`, `trust this folder|workspace|directory|repo` = 0 hits, and no per-MCP-server approval string. kiro's one tool-less dialog is the --trust-all-tools confirmation (component Rle: logo banner, 'Warning: Kiro is running in trust all tools mode', selector 'No, exit' / 'Yes, I accept' / 'Yes, and don't ask again', persisting chat.disableTrustAllConfirmation), and it renders IN PLACE OF the chat UI at launch, before any turn -- a delayed birth, not a working->waiting edge, the same disposition codex's sibling gives its two startup gates. It is also suppressed on this host (chat.disableTrustAllConfirmation: true). (3) SERVER-DRIVEN MCP ELICITATION: the vocabulary is compiled in (elicitation/create, CreateElicitationRequest/Result, ElicitationCapabilities/Form/Url, ElicitationSchema) but every symbol belongs to the rmcp protocol schema -- ClientCapabilities{roots,sampling,elicitation} is a serde field-name table, a type definition and not a declaration site -- or to sacp-11.0.0, the ACP client library behind `kiro-cli acp`, whose handler is `case Oo.elicitation_complete: if(!t.unstable_completeElicitation) return;`. No chat-TUI component renders it: setElicitation / pendingElicitation / ElicitationDialog / elicitationRequest = 0 hits, as are the user-facing strings such a dialog needs (`needs your input`, `requires input`, `server needs`, `input needed`), and none of the 30 crates/chat-cli-v2/src/**.rs paths in the string table mentions elicitation, permission or dialog -- while the chat REPL's tool-permission picker component IS findable verbatim by its option map. (4) AUTO-MODE / SETTINGS REVIEW: absent. kiro has an autopilot session config (setSessionConfigOption({configId:'autopilot',value:'on'}), telemetry chatAgentMode AUTOPILOT|SUPERVISED) set programmatically with no review dialog, and the /settings panels are user-invoked slash handlers; the 16 `auto-mode` hits are all Emacs Lisp symbol lists in a bundled grammar. WHY THE DAEMON PILLAR IS n/a: with agent=no there is nothing to observe. Stated for whoever revisits after the agent side changes, the daemon answer is already determined and would be `incapable`: a tool-less kiro dialog is invisible on BOTH channels. No hook -- kiro installs only `stop` and `postToolUse` (hooks.go), preToolUse is deliberately omitted per the #1716 audit, and kiro's event vocabulary has no Notification and no elicitation event, so unlike claudecode there is no matcher to widen and PermissionPending can never be set. No transcript trace -- the parser recognises exactly Prompt, AssistantMessage, ToolResults, Clear and skips the rest, and a dialog with no tool call writes no AssistantMessage and no toolUse, so nothing reaches the <uuid>.jsonl the FilesUnderRoot Source tails; TranscriptPermissionPending is copilot's signal (#1256) and this parser never sets it. DRIVER IS READY, not a gap: driver-interactive.sh implements send/keys/slash/wait_turn/sleep and DRIVE_ELICITS lists them all. VACUOUS-PASS WARNING: a kiro recording of this row could not tell 'the dialog never painted' from 'the dialog painted and the daemon saw nothing' -- both yield an events.jsonl with no waiting episode, and today both are the expected output. Any waiting such a recording DID show would by construction come from something else (a stray tool-permission picker via the open_tool_stalled rung, or the waiting-cue path). Never grade this row without independent proof the modal was on screen. Do not substitute the tool-permission picker: that behavior belongs to 2-19 tool-gate-permission-prompt and 2-26 permission-gate-non-mutating-tool. RE-ASSESS WHEN any of: kiro surfaces MCP elicitation in the chat REPL (a TUI component plus an `elicitation` capability actually declared on initialize); kiro gains a sandbox or network-access confirmation; the --trust-all-tools confirmation or any new trust gate moves to fire mid-turn rather than at launch; kiro adds a review dialog around the existing autopilot config; or kiro's hook event set gains a Notification-equivalent, which would also give the daemon a channel it does not have today.
